description: Help create an enjoyable working environment in your home or office with this Comfort Zone 6" 2-Speed Desk Fan with Clip. Equipped with two convenient speed settings, this quiet indoor fan lets you choose between low- and high-velocity output for efficient air circulation and optimized airflow that suits your space and your comfort level.

Whether you’re using this desk fan for work or home, you can direct the airflow where you need it. With the ability to rotate 360-degrees, this fan can provide targeted cooling in any direction. An adjustable tilt function lets you angle the head of the fan into a position that best suits your needs and then lock it into place by tightening the control knob on the side. When you wish to redirect the airflow, simply loosen the knob and adjust as needed.

This 2-speed cooling fan clips easily on to a desk, shelf or other convenient surface. A strong clamp keeps this plug-in fan with clip securely attached with a firm and reliable grip to prevent it from falling off while in use.

A convenient desk fan for work or home use, it features a coiled cord that can stretch to reach outlets without being too long or becoming easily tangled in smaller spaces. A built-in carry handle makes it possible to comfortably and safely transport this quiet portable fan from surface to surface or from room to room. It’s crafted with a coated safety grill that protects fingers and other objects from the moving blades when the fan is in use.
